concerns.text: FR-010 mandates a paired t‑test on variance differences between entropy‑matched prompt pairs, but no task in tasks.md implements this paired test (T004 uses Pearson correlation only).
SC-001 requires a paired t‑test on variance differences; the task list provides only independent two‑sample tests, leaving the required paired analysis uncovered.
FR-011 calls for a Spearman ρ correlation between activation variance and MSE quantization error, yet the tasks only compute Pearson correlations and do not perform the required Spearman analysis.
No task validates the JSON activation‑variance records against activation_schema.schema.yaml; a verification step is missing.
There is no task that validates data/processed/prompts.csv against the prompt_schema.schema.yaml contract.
The pipeline lacks a task that validates data/processed/entropy_scores.csv against the entropy_schema.schema.yaml contract.
